entities.summary: Lilla Karlsö is a small Swedish island in the Baltic Sea, situated about 3 km (1.9 mi) off the west coast of Gotland and 4.5 km (2.8 mi) from Stora Karlsö; it is part of Eksta socken. During summer there are tour boats from Djupvik 15 km (9.3 mi) south of Klintehamn.
